<!-- Adding pay to community-pay.json? Fill this in. Otherwise delete it. -->

**Adding an offer**
- [ ] It's a real offer I (or someone who gave permission) received
- [ ] No names or anything identifying a person
- [ ] Location, role and pay match the offer (pay is location-specific)
- [ ] `node scripts/validate-community.mjs` passes

Evidence (optional, **redact everything personal**): a cropped offer screenshot, a Levels.fyi link, or similar. Never post a full offer letter.
